scope: Actual RAW prefetch background worker cancellation, direction changes, disk count eviction and Metal frame preservation with two real EOS R8 CR3 sources
checks: Foreground ticket holds decoder permit while forward prefetch enters Checking
begin_foreground invalidates old forward generation before any RAW decode/publication
Backward RAW is actually decoded and persisted by production rrrah-raw-prefetch thread
Canceled forward source absent from disk after first backward plan
Persisted source matches independent native Rust decode in all original samples and metadata
Initial 1920x1080 and full 6188x4120 Metal frame bytes exact
Same worker and disk cache retained through next forward and backward plans
Each subsequent plan stores one source, evicts the opposite source, retains exactly one disk entry, and matches every full Metal pixel
Root and independent reference admission return to zero after each verification
limitations: Two EOS R8 CR3 files do not qualify all cameras or all 100 formats
Three successful worker plans are not a sustained large-collection soak
Cancellation is forced before decode while waiting for foreground permit; this does not test every mid-decode/mid-write race
Uses disk mosaic cache, not RAM swap or TTL, which have separate tests
Offscreen Metal frame comparison proves preservation relative to native decode, not independent color accuracy or physical HDR display
Ignored external corpus tests in ordinary gallery suite are not counted as passing
